usage_bridge_traceability.description: Allowed flag precedence over advisory saturation
Malformed report safe degradation without throw
Compact meter truthful quota percentage binding
CLI structured usage collection with fallback
No fake token conversions for non-token units

shadow_evaluator_traceability.scenario: Abundant quota, distant reset -> baseline scoring, no expiring boost
Abundant quota, imminent reset (queued_work=true) -> USE_IT_OR_LOSE_IT boost for subscription lane
Scarce quota, distant reset -> PRESERVE_SCARCE_QUOTA demotion
Scarce quota, imminent reset -> no boost (quota is scarce)
Model-scoped quota isolation -> quota for model A does not constrain model B
Account-wide quota application -> account ceiling applies to all matching lanes
UNKNOWN quota -> zero synthetic bonus, handled neutrally
STALE telemetry -> cannot outrank fresh authoritative telemetry
DEGRADED state -> when all lanes fail eligibility, returns DEGRADED safely
shadow_evaluator_traceability.test: T10 DEGRADED state on all lanes ineligible

shadow_evaluator_traceability.scenario: Explicit allowed=true -> does not block lane even if advisory usage is high
Explicit limitReached=true -> blocks constrained lane immediately
Free/local lane remains preferred where policy requires
Paid lane cannot be recommended when paid_authorized=false
shadow_evaluator_traceability.test: T14 paid lane forbidden without explicit spend authorization

shadow_evaluator_traceability.scenario: Actual and shadow decisions both recorded side-by-side
Shadow evaluation cannot mutate actual production decision
shadow_evaluator_traceability.test: T16 immutability and zero side-effects on actual route
